name: Cross-site Scripting
provenance: Written from the CWE-79 definition and Servlet / Spring MVC / JAX-RS / OWASP Encoder / commons-text / Grails GSP knowledge. The HTML-string-construction sink (concat/format of a markup literal with a dynamic part) is taken from general XSS knowledge AND from the PHP pass-2 diagnosis in ptest/notes (different dataset), not from eval_slices.

gsp.doc: ${...} / <%= %> expressions are output. Safe = literal, or wrapped in an HTML/attribute/URL/JS encoder, a message lookup or a numeric. A JavaScript-STRING escaper (escapeJs, js) is not an HTML encoder and is not listed.

notes: S1 = unit has an output sink / HTML-building string / (.gsp) output expression. S2 = at least one such sink has a dynamic part not wrapped in an HTML encoder. .gsp templates are file-scope units.
